description: Audit a parcel against municipal code enforcement and 311 blight databases (unfit dwellings, demolition orders, exterior violations) to calculate statutory obsolescence deductions and generate Exhibit B-1 under T.C.A. § 67-5-601(a) and § 13-21-103.

format.description: Output format: 'json' (default) or 'html' for ready-to-file Exhibit B-1

jurisdiction.description: County or municipal jurisdiction name (e.g. Chattanooga, Hamilton, Memphis, Nashville, Knoxville)

market_value.description: Optional current total appraised or market value

name: audit_parcel_blight_citations
